{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Filter for converted customers AND valid age (not -1)
converted_data = data[(data['converted'] == 1) & (data['customer_age'] != -1)]

# Compute mean age
mean_age = converted_data['customer_age'].mean()

# Output the result
print(f"Mean age of customers who converted (excluding age = -1): {mean_age}")

# Also report count for transparency
print(f"Number of converted customers with valid age: {len(converted_data)}")"}
